newsitem.title: USA: Texas girl dies after freak tree accident.
newsitem.headline: Texas girl dies after freak tree accident.

text.p: A nine-year-old Texas girl has died after a freak accident in which a huge tree limb fell on her and 17 other children at a summer carnival, officials said Friday.

Tenisha Wright suffered serious head and chest injuries when she was crushed Thursday by the 40-foot limb of a cottonwood tree at a park in Waco, Texas and was flown to a Fort Worth children's hospital for emergency treatment.
A hospital spokeswoman said she died late Thursday night.
The tree limb broke off and fell onto a group of about 35 children as they stood in line at a dunking booth on the banks of the Brazos River.
An eight-year-old girl was in serious condition with head injuries, a seven-year-old boy suffered a liver laceration and at least two other boys had broken bones.
About 500 children attended the "Fun in Sun" event at a Waco community centre. Waco fire officials said the tree may have been weakened by a storm which hit the area earlier this week.
